svg.title: Hacks
svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for Hacks on lifehacker.dev. Real fixes for real problems — the dev kind and the life kind — with the failed attempts left in. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for hacks posts that carry no banner of their own. Seed 3707896191.
